name: setup
js: (() => { const b = document.getElementById("btn-toggle-hud"); if (b && !document.body.classList.contains("film")) { b.click(); document.body.classList.add("film"); } })();

name: zoo-ready
js: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 60000) { const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; if (!Z || ['models', 'failed', 'off'].includes(Z.state)) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; return Z ? { state: Z.state, models: Z.models, failed: Z.failed, anim: Z.anim && { enabled: Z.anim.enabled, t: Z.anim.t, seed: Z.anim.seed } } : null; })()
